name: calendar
description: Calendars over CalDAV: accounts added through the API (Fastmail, iCloud, Nextcloud…), events synced and queryable — agenda, today, upcoming.
env_example: # How many days ahead the sync pulls.
post_install: Restart the platform: docker compose restart endpoint-platform (applies 011_calendar.sql, hot-loads the apps).

Add a calendar account: curl -s -X POST http://127.0.0.1:{{PORT_PLATFORM}}/api/calendar/accounts -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"label": "personal", "username": "you@fastmail.com", "password": "app-password", "provider": "fastmail"}'
Providers: fastmail, icloud (app-specific password), nextcloud (your server URL), or 'caldav' with a custom caldav_url. Passwords live in the vault.
Sync pulls the next 30 days every 30 minutes: GET /api/calendar/upcoming
